note: Tank's body: its hurt and push boxes, which every move starts from ("base"), and the stand-in for a move with no file yet: the guard pose, held. Not a loop itself: a move based on it says "loop": true if it loops (the exporter makes the stand-ins of idle, walk_f, walk_b, crouch and block loop). The treads are hurtable along their whole length (they stick out 2.7 m ahead and behind); the push box is 2.4 m either side, so the other mech's toes come just over the tread's nose.
